# CSP Discovery Procedures 

This document outlines the key steps for pre-assessing subscriptions before transferring to a Cloud Solution Provider (CSP).

This process allows the Azure subscriber to verify whether the Microsoft CSP transfer tool works as expected or identify any additional steps needed for a smooth transition to CSP. 
##
## Prerequisites
- Customer must be logged into the Azure Portal with **Global Admin** and **Subscription Owner** accounts
- Customer must be able to launch Azure Cloud Shell

## Data Gathering procedures
Please email all files and responses to your Softchoice contact for review.

1. Run the script and collect the required data ([Instructions below](#_run_the_script))
1. Screenshots of Subscription Overview, Subscription Properties and Billing profile of each subscription ([Instructions below]()) 
1. Screenshot Reserved Instance details **(Yes/No. If Yes,** [Instructions below](#_screenshot_reserved_instances))
1. Document Azure Marketplace items **(Yes/No. If Yes, Include name & vendor in the email)** 
1. Subscription Quota increase acknowledgement **(Yes/No. If Yes, Include answer in the email)** 

## Data Collected 
- Subscription Name, ID, Azure Resource Name, Resource ID, Type, and SKU

NOTE: Customer Data gathered by this script is only high-level. We do not gather customer usernames, passwords, secrets, tokens, certificates, service principals, AAD data, or data from any storage resource
